Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of fundamental thermodynamic principles regarding the direction of heat flow. The agent incorrectly concluded that thermal energy flows in "both directions" or selected an option implying bidirectional flow as the "best description," whereas the standard scientific definition of heat flow (thermal energy transfer) is strictly from the hotter object (tea) to the colder object (ice) until thermal equilibrium is reached. Additionally, the agent failed to select the correct option from the provided list (Option B) and instead invented a non-existent option (C) that contradicts the unidirectional nature of net heat transfer.
